Secondary uncertainty analysis for the independent casting cohort
Recorded after the main analysis specification and before scoring the selected source file. This is an internal analysis note and does not change the primary endpoint or eligibility.

For a test period with at least 15 observed dates, quantify the variability of the primary fixed-ranking difference in detections per 100 inspections using a circular moving-block bootstrap of five consecutive observed dates. Use the original daily Hamilton quotas and the original held-out scores. Draw blocks starting uniformly at any test date, with replacement, until as many dates as in the test period have been drawn; truncate the last block to that number. For each of 10,000 draws with NumPy default_rng(20261123), compute 100 times the sum of coupled-minus-RBF detections divided by the sum of inspection slots on the sampled days. Use the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of draws with positive inspection slots. Report the observed difference and interval as a conditional sensitivity analysis within one observed process. It does not cover retraining, alternative date splits, between-plant variability, or a new production regime. The resampling unit is the recorded date, and gaps in the public file do not represent observed zero-production dates. Also report counts of days on which the primary pair had larger, equal, or smaller defect counts.
